channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Saúde tem saldo positivo para o governo Lula, indica pesquisa BTG/Nexus
item.description: BTG/Nexus poll shows 32% of voters attribute improved health services to President Lula's government, while 27% claim deterioration. The health sector remains a key national topic, particularly post-pandemic. The result opposes budget cuts and supports federal interventions.

item.title: Quem é o eleitor que está fazendo Lula e Flávio oscilarem nas pesquisas
item.description: The race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro appears evenly matched in polls, driven by voters critical of the government shifting toward the opposition. The Quaest poll shows Lula with 36% of first-round vote intentions against Flávio's 31%, while in the second round the PL candidate leads within the margin of error.

item.title: Bahia vence Remo, ultrapassa Fluminense e entra no G4 do Brasileirão
item.description: In the 27th round of the Brazilian Championship, Bahia defeated Remo 2-1 at Arena Fonte Nova with goals from Jean Lucas and Luciano Juba, surpassing Fluminense to take 4th place with 46 points. Remo remains in 19th position with 23 points.

item.title: Julgamento de Alexandre de Moraes: o que sabe sobre sessão inédita do STF
item.description: The STF holds a precedent-setting session to decide on opening an investigation against Minister Alexandre de Moraes over messages with banker Daniel Vorcaro. The vote will follow the order of seniority among justices, excluding Toffoli, and will be broadcast live.

item.title: Desconfiança de eleitores no STF cresce e chega a 56%, diz Quaest
item.description: Voter distrust in the STF reached 56% according to a September 2026 Quaest survey. Justice Minister André Mendonça is viewed as acting correctly, whereas Minister Moraes faces divided opinions. Court crisis contributes to distrust.

item.title: Sóstenes diz que Quaest está “com delay” sobre alta de Flávio
item.description: PL leader Sóstenes Cavalcante claimed the Quaest poll lags behind Flávio Bolsonaro's recent growth, showing him leading Lula 42% to 40% in a hypothetical runoff. He credited the PL's intensified street mobilization for the shift.

item.title: Imprensa europeia exalta Davide Ancelotti após bom início no Lille
item.description: Davide Ancelotti, former Botafogo coach and ex-Brazil national team assistant, took over Lille and currently leads the French league with three wins and one draw. European media, including Spanish newspaper 'AS', praised the Italian's appointment, highlighting his promising start at the French club.

item.title: Governo fará regra para transparência de algoritmos de apps de entrega
item.description: The federal government will publish an infralegal rule by next week to increase transparency of algorithms used by ride-hailing and delivery apps, addressing worker complaints about unjustified blocks and establishing appeal mechanisms for contested automated decisions.

item.title: Flávio diz que STF “tem obrigação” de autorizar investigação contra Moraes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that the STF has an obligation to authorize an investigation against Minister Alexandre de Moraes, during a motorcycle rally in Belém. The STF will hold an extraordinary session to decide on opening an investigation regarding messages between Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro. The candidate also advocated for greater transparency in Supreme Court investigations.

item.title: Filho de Mario Covas pede expulsão do presidente do PSDB de SP
item.description: Mario Covas Neto requests the expulsion of the São Paulo state president of PSDB, Paulo Serra, accusing him of disloyalty and support for candidates from other parties in municipal elections. The filing highlights Serra's backing of André do Prado and Guilherme Derrite, as well as events organized outside party deliberations. Covas Neto asks for national intervention in the state directory.

item.title: Prefeitura de SP aciona STF para blindar contrato de Wi-Fi após decisão de Flávio Dino
item.description: The São Paulo City Hall filed a lawsuit with the STF to protect the Wi-Fi Livre SP contract after a decision by Flávio Dino affecting the Instituto Conhecer Brasil. The PGM questions whether the decision impacts the agreement with the entity led by Karina Gama, partner of the producer responsible for the Jair Bolsonaro biopic. The initiative aims to ensure legal security and prevent interruption of free internet service.

item.title: SP1 entrevista Tarcísio de Freitas nesta terça
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas will be interviewed live on SP1, TV Globo's news program, this Tuesday as part of the interview series with São Paulo gubernatorial candidates. Conducted by journalist Alan Severiano, the interview will air simultaneously on g1 and later be available on Globoplay and g1. This marks the broadcaster's second interview with the contenders for São Paulo state government.

item.title: PGR pede esclarecimentos sobre sigilo dos pagamentos de Vorcaro
item.description: The Brazilian Attorney General's Office requested clarifications from Minister André Mendonça regarding measures taken in an investigation into payments linked to Master founder Daniel Vorcaro. Deputy Attorney General Hindenburgo Chateaubriand noted the lack of information on actions by the investigating judge, as the Supreme Court reviews a Federal Police report with evidence of ties between Vorcaro and Moraes. The release of a petition revealed payments, including to Vorcaro's nephew Fabiano Zettel, amid disputes among justices over evidence access.

item.title: Lula critica quem diz que governo “gasta muito” em políticas públicas
item.description: Lula criticized the view that public policies are expenses, defending them as investments for social inclusion. During the sanction of the bill making Move Brasil permanent, he emphasized the need for state and business collaboration to expand opportunities.

item.title: PF pediu a Mendonça há 6 meses relatório financeiro sobre autoridade com foro; PGR quer saber se ministro fez algo
item.description: The Brazilian Republic Prosecutor's Office (PGR) questioned the president of the STF, Minister Edson Fachin, about the progress of a financial intelligence report requested by the Federal Police in March 2026, related to an authority with privileged jurisdiction, without revealing their identity. The case is linked to the Master case investigation and the lifting of secrecy involving banker Daniel Vorcaro and Banco Master.

item.title: Brasil espera reunião sobre tarifaço com os EUA à margem do G20
item.description: The Brazilian government hopes for an in-person meeting with USTR at the G20 sidelines in Miami to discuss tariffs imposed by the US. Negotiations resumed after a phone call between Lula and Trump, with topics like Pix, digital commerce, and intellectual property on the agenda. No definitive agreement is expected before the elections.

item.title: Lula sanciona Redata na 3ª feira e PL dos minerais críticos na 4ª
item.description: President Lula will sign the Redata law on Tuesday, granting tax incentives for data centers, and the National Policy for Critical and Strategic Minerals on Wednesday, both approved by Congress as strategic priorities. These projects create tax benefits long awaited by the digital infrastructure and mining sectors, with ceremonies scheduled at the Planalto Palace on September 15 and 16, 2026. Although approved, key details remain to be regulated, but the government does not plan to modify the texts.

item.title: Renan Santos anuncia caravana por ao menos 37 cidades
item.description: Presidential candidate Renan Santos (Missão) launched the 'Tour Futuro Glorioso' caravan, which will travel through 37 cities across seven Southern and Southeastern states from September 15 to 30, featuring 24/7 live streams and Federal Police escort. The initiative combines in-person events with digital content and includes participation from figures linked to MBL.

item.title: Brasileiro desconectado e exausto se afasta das urnas, aponta estudo
item.description: A study by Datafolha, in partnership with the Desapocalíptica project, reveals growing voter fatigue and disengagement in Brazil, particularly among young people who view elections as a duty or loss-avoidance tactic. The survey finds a clear link between low social connection, despair, and reduced electoral participation, with 46% of 'disconnected' respondents reporting little to no voting in recent elections. While 60% of respondents say they would not abandon democracy under any government, support drops sharply among those with weaker social ties.

item.title: Lobista investigado no escândalo do INSS disputa vaga de suplente ao Senado
item.description: Lobbist Danilo Trento, investigated in the INSS irregular discounts scandal and the Covid CPI, was chosen as first alternate of Senate candidate Janaina Riva (MDB-MT), replacing Aluízio Lima and Ibrahim Zaher on the ticket. The choice was formalized after changes to the candidate slate before the TSE.

item.title: Governo Lula definirá regras sobre transparência do algoritmo para apps
item.description: The Lula government is set to publish a normative rule to regulate algorithmic transparency for ride-hailing and delivery platforms, addressing worker complaints about unjustified account blocks. He also signed a bill establishing the Move Brasil financing program as a permanent government policy for drivers, taxi operators, and delivery workers.

item.title: Lula recebeu “vítimas das bets” no Alvorada: “É doença, não é jogo”
item.description: President Lula met with victims of online gambling, calling it a 'disease' and signaling upcoming regulatory measures. He also signed a bill making the Move Brasil credit program permanent for drivers and school transporters.

item.title: Incerteza eleitoral pode adiar até R$ 62 bilhões em consumo no varejo nacional
item.description: A study by IBEVAR-FIA shows that the high electoral uncertainty in 2026 may delay up to R$62 billion in national retail consumption. With the two main candidates tied, the EPU-Brazil index hits a record high, reinforcing consumer hesitation toward high-value purchases.

item.title: A crise do Supremo não termina com as urnas
item.description: The article argues that the Supreme Federal Court faces an institutional crisis that will not be resolved solely through elections, emphasizing the political role of constitutional judges. Ignoring this reality undermines trust in elected powers and creates unrealistic expectations that the judiciary alone can fix institutional problems.

item.title: Lula é o 7º presidente mais popular da América Latina em setembro; veja o ranking
item.description: Lula ranks as the 7th most popular president in Latin America in September, with 48.5% positive image and 49.2% negative, according to CB Global Data. The left leads the ranking with Mexico's Claudia Sheinbaum, who tops with 69% positive image.

item.title: Quaest: 37% avaliam que Mendonça age de forma correta na crise do STF; 16% defendem Moraes
item.description: Quaest survey reveals that 37% of Brazilians consider Minister André Mendonça acting correctly in the STF crisis, against 16% who point to Alexandre de Moraes. The positioning varies significantly among political groups: 67% of right-wing non-bolsonarist voters support Mendonça, while 34% of lulists consider Moraes correct.

item.title: ‘Epidemia das bets’: O drama de quem tenta se livrar do vício em apostas online
item.description: The article explores the public health crisis driven by the rise of online betting, highlighting the impact of gambling addiction on millions of Brazilians and the role of support groups like Anonymous Players. It also addresses how influencers and celebrities contribute to normalizing betting, alongside social consequences such as debt and loan shark violence.

item.title: Flávio é o único candidato a não mandar representante para debate sobre saúde na Fiesp
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro was the only presidential candidate among the top poll leaders to not send a representative to the Fiesp health debate. During the event, the space remained open for his participation. Among those present were advisors for Lula, Caiado, Zema, Renan, and Augusto Cury.

item.title: Flávio e PL lideram uso político de deepfakes na pré-campanha, revela levantamento
item.description: A survey revealed that candidates and political parties extensively used deepfakes during the pre-election campaign, with PL leading the adoption of the technology to attack opponents. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and Congressman Mário Frias were the main adopters, and over 60% of synthetic content targeted politicians such as Lula, Jair Bolsonaro, and Supreme Court justices.

item.title: Quaest: 67% dizem que crise no STF não influencia voto para presidente
item.description: A Quaest survey shows 67% of Brazilians say the STF crisis does not influence their presidential vote, while 22% say it reinforces their current choice and only 7% consider changing candidates. The crisis involves abuse of power allegations against Minister Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: FGV Direito SP reúne professores e alunos para acompanhar sessão do STF sobre Moraes
item.description: FGV Law School SP hosted public session discussing STF investigation against Minister Alexandre de Moraes. Faculty and students gathered to analyze implications for judicial independence. Debate reflected tensions between government branches in Brazilian democracy.

item.title: Desconfiança no STF cresce 10 pontos em meio à crise, aponta Quaest
item.description: A new Quaest poll shows 53% of Brazilians support a code of ethics and fixed terms for Supreme Court justices, while distrust in the Court rose by 10 points to 56%. The STF crisis deepened ahead of a session that may authorize an investigation into Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Ibovespa desvaloriza com preços do petróleo e Superquarta no radar
item.description: The Ibovespa dropped 0.91% to 185,500 points, pressured by oil prices and caution ahead of Copom and Fed interest rate decisions. Tensions between the US and Iran pushed Brent to $105, while the Focus report lowered the 2026 inflation forecast to 4.90%, keeping the Selic at 13.75% annually. The monetary policy assessments on Wednesday will be key to defining the interest rate path in Brazil and the US.

item.title: Lula x Flávio: o que explica as diferenças nos números das pesquisas Quaest e Nexus
item.description: The Quaest and Nexus polls show significant differences in voting intentions between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, especially in the Southeast. While Quaest indicates a tie in the second round with a slight advantage for Flávio, Nexus keeps Lula ahead. The biggest contrast is the percentage of undecided voters, ranging from 10% in Quaest to 2% in Nexus.

item.title: Platense x Fluminense: prováveis escalações, onde assistir, como chegam, arbitragem e palpite
item.description: Fluminense faces Platense in Argentina for the Copa Libertadores quarterfinal second leg, holding a 2-0 advantage from the first match and able to advance even with a one-goal loss. The game takes place at 7 PM Brasília time at Ciudad de Vicente López Stadium, broadcasted by ESPN and Disney+, with the referee yet to be announced. Coach Marcão will miss key players like Nonato and Germán Cano but can rely on the starting squad to aim for the semifinals.

item.title: STF define como será julgamento sobre investigação de Moraes e ministro terá direito de se defender
item.description: The STF set the procedure to judge a possible investigation against Alexandre de Moraes in the Banco Master case, allowing oral arguments and defense. The decision will rely on the PF report and involves figures like Moraes, Mendonça, Fachin and Gonet amid internal disputes in the court.

item.title: Confira o rito do julgamento que vai decidir se abre investigação contra Moraes por ligações com Vorcaro
item.description: STF will hold hearing to decide whether to open investigation into Alexandre de Moraes based on dialogues with Daniel Vorcaro. Session includes report reading, PGR statements and minister votes, with result announced at end. Hearing follows strict procedural rite set by court.

item.title: Fachin divulga rito genérico e será o 1º a votar em sessão histórica do STF sobre Vorcaro e Moraes
item.description: The STF released a generic procedural framework for the historic session reviewing the PF report linking Moraes to Vorcaro. The ruling takes place Tuesday, with Fachin casting the first vote. The case involves investigations into suspected irregularities at Banco Master.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula nas pesquisas presidenciais: veja levantamentos
item.description: Recent polls measure the 2026 race between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), including first and second round simulations.

item.title: Haddad tenta colar Vorcaro em Tarcísio, mas governador amplia vantagem
item.description: Fernando Haddad attempts to link Daniel Vorcaro to Tarcísio de Freitas' administration to deflect criticism, as the governor widens his lead in polls. The PT strategist aims to expose alleged failures of the Republican administration, but Tarcísio's campaign seems more resilient to backlash.

item.title: Lula prorroga crédito de R$ 30 bi para motoristas de aplicativo e inclui vans escolares
item.description: President Lula signed a bill extending the Move Brasil Taxi and Apps program, releasing R$30 billion in subsidized credit for vehicle purchases by taxi, app, and school transport drivers, including school vans.

item.title: Zema e Sebastião Coelho organizam ato contra Moraes em dia de sessão do STF
item.description: The Partido Novo organized a protest against STF Minister Alexandre de Moraes, with Romeu Zema and Sebastião Coelho present, accusing the judge of abuse of power and violations of freedoms. The event coincides with an extraordinary STF session that will analyze cases linked to messages allegedly exchanged by Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro. The PMDF has strengthened security near the Praça dos Três Poderes.

item.title: Como será sessão do STF que vai julgar mensagens entre Moraes e Vorcaro
item.description: The STF will hold a first-of-its-kind session to judge the message exchange between Minister Moraes and former Banco Master owner Daniel Vorcaro. The session, scheduled for 10am, will follow a procedure with Justice Edson Fachin voting as rapporteur. Questions remain about whether Moraes, Mendonça, Toffoli and the attorney general can participate in the vote.

item.title: Lula perde posição no ranking de popularidade entre presidentes
item.description: President Lula (PT) dropped from 6th to 7th place in the regional popularity ranking by CB Global Data, with his positive image falling from 51.9% to 48.5% between August and September. The survey, conducted with 4,275 Brazilians, shows his standing in a balanced state without a linear recovery, reflecting the tighter scenario seen in recent domestic polls.

item.title: STF tem conspiratas e pedido de reforço de segurança para julgamento de Moraes
item.description: The STF requests increased security following threats and suspected illegal surveillance, deepening internal crisis. Justices live in mistrust and may investigate Moraes over ties with Daniel Vorcaro. The DF government bans political demonstrations near the court.

item.title: Entorno de ministros compara conduta de Mendonça à de golpistas às vésperas da eleição
item.description: Minister André Mendonça ordered an investigation into Minister Alexandre de Moraes shortly before the 2026 elections, drawing criticism from colleagues who compare him to coup plotters. The Supreme Court crisis affects election polls, with Flávio Bolsonaro gaining ground and pressure mounting on candidate Lula.

item.title: Crusoé: Eleitores de Renan são os que mais migram para Flávio, aponta Quaest
item.description: A Quaest survey shows that 50% of Renan Santos' voters would shift to Flávio Bolsonaro in a runoff against Lula, while 18% would support Lula and 26% would not vote for either. Despite repeated criticisms, the data reveals greater vote transfer from Renan's base to the PL senator.

item.title: Crise no STF: 68% defendem aumentar exigências para nomeação de ministros, mostra Quaest
item.description: A Quaest poll shows that 68% of Brazilians support raising requirements for Supreme Court appointments, and 53% favor fixed terms and an ethics code for justices. The internal conflict at the Court, involving justices Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça, aligns with rising public distrust, as 56% say they do not trust the Supreme Court.

item.title: Bia Kicis pede votos e orienta eleitores em almoço de empresa do agro
item.description: Bia Kicis (PL-DF) solicited votes for herself and allied candidates during a lunch hosted by Três Pinheiros Sementes in Formosa (GO), claiming it was a birthday gathering rather than a campaign event. She guided voters on the ballot order and endorsed Michelle Bolsonaro, Celina Leão, Flávio Bolsonaro, and other allies.

item.title: Mineiros vão eleger 133 representantes nas Eleições 2026; veja quais cargos
item.description: Over 16 million eligible voters in Minas Gerais will head to the polls on October 4th to elect the president, governor, two senators, 53 federal deputies, and 77 state deputies. The election will also determine national positions including 27 governors, 54 senators, and 513 federal deputies. Minas Gerais holds one of the largest caucuses in the Chamber of Deputies with 53 seats.
